<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a series of peaks spaced by ~1.003 Da with relative intensities that match the expected 13C distribution (M+1 ≈ 17 % of M, M+2 ≈ 1.6 % of M, etc.)—the only element that can be definitively identified from this spectrum is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
